app.name: TradeRock
app.tagline: Pokémon trading with FireRed and LeafGreen on Switch

common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

demo.explain: Nothing is really traded: TradeRock simulates the Switch so you can learn the steps.

status.title: App status
status.error: Could not reach the internal server

home.title: Welcome to TradeRock
home.intro: TradeRock pretends to be a second Switch in the FireRed and LeafGreen trade room. That way you send Pokémon from your PC to your game and keep the ones you receive.

pokemon.title: My Pokémon
pokemon.subtitle: Everything you imported or received is stored here. (The full vault comes in a later stage.)
pokemon.dropHint: or drag files onto this area
pokemon.empty: No Pokémon yet. Import a .pk3 or .ek3 file.
pokemon.evolvesWarning: Evolves when traded. Right now the Switch may freeze while saving after a trade evolution (known engine issue). Consider holding an Everstone.

fileErrors.size: not a Gen 3 Pokémon (80 or 100 bytes)

pokemon.savIntro: Choose a GBA save (FireRed, LeafGreen, Ruby, Sapphire or Emerald). The file is not changed.

savErrors.sav_expired: the read expired, upload the file again

party.title: Build the PC party
party.needTwo: Put at least 2 Pokémon in the party.
party.needOffered: Mark at least 1 Pokémon to go to the Switch.
party.illegalBlocked: Illegal: blocked from going to the Switch (see Settings › Illegal Pokémon).
party.acceptIllegal: I understand I'm sending an illegal Pokémon to my game.

trainer.title: Game and simulated trainer
trainer.name: Trainer name
trainer.nameHelp: Up to 7 characters, no accents. It's the name you'll approve on the Switch.

simulation.title: Simulation
simulation.help: Choose what the simulated Switch will do, to see each situation.

scenario.connect_failures_then_success: Fails a few times, then connects
scenario.approval_never_given: Nobody approves the request on the Switch

live.cancelConfirm: Cancel the trade now? TradeRock closes the connection safely.

errors.trades_exceed_party: there are more trades than Pokémon in the party
errors.offered_slots_repeated: the same Pokémon was marked twice
errors.offered_slot_out_of_range: a marked Pokémon is not in the party
errors.party_data_size: a party file is not a valid Pokémon
errors.trainer_name_too_long: the name has more than 7 characters
errors.trainer_name_invalid_chars: the name has characters the game doesn't support (accents, _ …)
errors.unknown_pokemon: a party Pokémon was not found
errors.preset_label_invalid: give the saved trainer a short name
errors.busy: a trade is already in progress
errors.illegal_pokemon: a Pokémon marked for the Switch is illegal. Fix it in the builder or enable advanced mode in Settings.
errors.illegal_needs_confirmation: confirm that you want to send an illegal Pokémon

failures.no_network_found: The Switch's room was not found. Check that the Direct Corner is open as Leader and the Switch is close by.
failures.beacon_not_decrypted: The room was found, but the keys (prod.keys) don't match.
failures.join_failed: The connection to the Switch didn't complete.
failures.join_rejected: The Switch rejected the join request.
failures.approval_timeout: The join request wasn't approved on the Switch in time.
failures.connect_timeout: Connecting to the room took too long.
failures.phase_timeout: The trade was stuck for too long.
failures.total_timeout: The trade exceeded the maximum time.
failures.host_cancelled: The trade was cancelled on the Switch.
failures.connection_lost: The connection dropped during the trade.
failures.engine_crashed: The trade engine stopped with an error.

settings.title: Settings
settings.engineHelp: The engine is what talks to the Switch. The real engines (Wi-Fi card and ESP32) come in the next stages.
settings.maxAttemptsHelp: How many times TradeRock tries to connect before giving up. Connecting to the Switch sometimes takes a few attempts.
settings.phaseTimeoutSeconds: Maximum idle time inside the room (seconds)
settings.nationalDex: My save already has the National Pokédex
settings.choosePokemon: Pick a Pokémon you caught on the Switch
settings.allowIllegalHelp: Off: TradeRock won't send the Switch a Pokémon PKHeX considers illegal. On: each trade with an illegal one still asks for confirmation.

close.title: Close during a trade?
close.body: A trade is in progress. If you close now, TradeRock cancels it safely before quitting. Pokémon already received stay stored.

builder.title: Create Pokémon
builder.originHelp: Where the Pokémon came from (catch, gift, event…).
builder.noMyTrainer: Set up "My trainer" in Settings to use your save data.
builder.savedDuplicate: This Pokémon was already in the vault.
builder.genFailed: The generator couldn't find a possible combination for this request. See the problems below and try loosening something (nature, IVs, shiny or origin).
builder.genTimeout: Generation took too long. Try loosening the request.
builder.showdownPlaceholder: Paste one or more sets in Showdown format…
builder.openedFrom: Opened from the vault: saving creates a new copy (the original stays stored).

errors.ot_invalid: OT name must have 1 to 7 characters

blockers.shiny: Shiny: doesn’t fit the rest of the request. Without shiny, it works.
blockers.nature: Nature: doesn’t fit the rest of the request. With “any”, it works.
blockers.ivs: IVs: these IVs can’t come with the rest of the request. With “any”, it works.
blockers.moves: Moves: some move can’t be learned this way. Without the moves, it works.
blockers.ball: Poké Ball: not possible for this encounter. With “any”, it works.
blockers.ability: Ability: doesn’t fit the rest of the request.
blockers.gender: Gender: doesn’t fit the rest of the request.
blockers.origin: Origin: doesn’t work with the chosen origin. With automatic origin, it works.
blockers.combination: The combination: each request works alone, but not all together. Try loosening two or more.
blockers.species_unobtainable: Species: no way to obtain it in Gen 3 games.

legality.unverifiableExplain: PKHeX doesn't know this event Pokémon's origin. It's marked neither legal nor illegal.
legality.fishyNote: ! = PKHeX notice. It doesn't make the Pokémon illegal.

warnings.mythical_not_fateful: Mew/Deoxys without the event flag: the game refuses to trade it and it never obeys.
warnings.national_dex_unknown: Species from outside Kanto: the game only trades it if your save has the National Pokédex. Set up "My trainer" to confirm.
warnings.national_dex_required: Your save doesn't have the National Pokédex yet: normally the game won't trade Pokémon above #151.
warnings.trade_evolution: Evolves when traded. Right now the Switch may freeze while saving after a trade evolution (known engine issue). Consider holding an Everstone.
warnings.obedience: Level {{level}} is above the obedience limit ({{limit}}) for {{badges}} badge(s): since it belongs to another trainer, it may disobey in battle.
